author: Rogue Hobbies
description:
everyone seemed to like this reel over on insta so I'm sharing it here!! 

im sooo excited to talk about these paints in a bit more detail caus I have MANY thoughts and you guys have many questions!

But for now, this was nuts. I promise you there was no thinning or clean up in post or anything like that, this was the THICKEST coat straight out the pot and I am very impressed and a little confused lol.

And just to be clear, I wasn't paid to make this video nor did I get anything for free and this isn't sponsored or anything like that either, I just like an excuse to play around with some new paints! 

also I don't recommend this as an actual technique, there's much more controlled ways to basecoat and you'll rinse through your expensive paints if you do it often, I just wanted to push the theory as far as I could!!

but maybe a whole vid coming soon!!!
title: The new GW paints are One thick Coat proof? #warhammer #warhammer40k #warhammer40000 #painting
